{{Current events|year=2025|month=02|day=19|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[M23 campaign (2022–present)|M23 campaign]]
***[[2025 Uvira offensive]]
****Widespread [[Civil disorder|civil disorder]] arises in [[Uvira]], [[South Kivu Province]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] amid [[March 23 Movement|M23]] rebel advances from [[Bukavu]]. At least thirty deaths are reported, along with [[looting]] and a [[Prison escape|prison break]] of 228 [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese soldiers]] imprisoned for [[Desertion|desertion]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/rebel-advance-causes-panic-congolese-border-town-uvira-2025-02-19/ (Reuters)]
***Following a meeting between [[President of Chad|Chadian president]] [[Mahamat Déby]] and a diplomatic envoy of [[President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese president]] [[Félix Tshisekedi]], the [[Government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese government]] formally requests military support from [[Chad]] in their ongoing conflict against the M23 movement. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/dr-congo-seeks-chad-s-support-to-combat-m23-rebels-report/3486999 (Anadolou Agency)]
***The [[United Nations Security Council]] holds an emergency meeting in response to rapid territorial gains made by M23 rebels, with U.N. special envoy for Congo [[Bintou Keita]] saying the council needed to take "urgent and decisive steps to avert a wider regional war." [https://apnews.com/article/un-congo-m23-rwanda-congo-1bdddcf00dd15e0e4898fb0197e96920 (AP)]
*[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
**[[Puntland counter-terrorism operations]]
***[[Puntland Police Force|Puntland police]] capture several [[Islamic State – Somalia Province|IS–Somalia]] militants accused of involvement in [[Extortion|extortion]] and [[Bomb|bombings]] in [[Bosaso]], the capital of the [[Bari Region]], amid [[Puntland counter-terrorism operations|ongoing military operations]] in the [[Cal Miskaad]] mountains. [https://garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/somalia-puntland-forces-capture-isis-members-involved-in-extortion-and-bombings (Garowe Online)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***At least one person is killed and 14 others are injured in [[Russia]]n [[missile]] and [[drone strike]]s across [[Ukraine]], including a large drone attack on energy infrastructure in [[Odesa]] that leaves 160,000 residents without heating and electricity. [https://kyivindependent.com/attacks-127/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**The [[Chad National Army]] announces the end of its four-month Operation Haskanite, an offensive in the [[Lake Chad]] area against [[Boko Haram]], and that 297 terrorists and 27 soldiers have been killed. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/nearly-300-militants-killed-in-boko-haram-offensive-says-chad/article69237162.ece (''The Hindu'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Two [[light aircraft]], a [[Lancair 360|Lancair 360 MK II]] and a [[Cessna 172S]], collide midair at [[Marana Regional Airport]] near [[Tucson, Arizona|Tucson]], [[Arizona]], [[United States]], killing two people. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/aircraft-collision-arizona-airport-leaves-least-1-person-dead-rcna192843 (NBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Ukraine–United States relations]]
***Amid deteriorating relations between both countries, [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] calls [[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] a "[[dictator]]" and says he has done a "terrible job" while warning "he is not going to have a country left" soon. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cjev2j70v19o (BBC News)]
**[[Russia–United States relations]]
***[[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] praises the high-level talks with the U.S. in [[Riyadh]], [[Saudi Arabia]], as a "first step" towards restoring full diplomatic ties with the [[United States]]. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2025/02/19/putin-praises-us-russia-talks-as-first-step-toward-restoring-ties-a88081 (''The Moscow Times'')]
*[[Belgium–Rwanda relations]]
**[[Rwanda]] suspends a [[humanitarian aid]] pact with [[Belgium]] after [[List of foreign ministers of Belgium|Belgian Foreign Minister]] [[Maxime Prévot]] criticized Rwanda's military support for the [[March 23 Movement|M23 rebel movement]] in [[Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://euroweeklynews.com/2025/02/19/rwanda-suspends-aid-pact-with-belgium-over-support-for-congo-rebels/ (Euro Weekly News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2020s European re-armament]]
**[[Denmark]] announces 50 billion [[Danish krone|kroner]] in defense spending over the next two years, citing an increased threat from Russia, bringing the country's total defense spending to the highest in more than 50 years. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/c62e2158mkpt (BBC News)] 
*Former [[President of Brazil|Brazilian President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]] is formally charged with leading the [[2022 Brazilian coup plot]], which attempted to overthrow current President [[Lula da Silva]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazil-general-prosecutor-charges-bolsonaro-alleged-coup-plot-2025-02-19/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Polish police]] inspects several tanks from a [[SpaceX]] [[Falcon 9]] rocket that crashed in [[Poland|the country]] after its reentry into the atmosphere during the night. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c62z3vxjplpo (BBC)] [https://tvn24.pl/poznan/wielkopolska-znaleziono-kolejny-niezidentyfikowany-obiekt-st8313991 (TVN24)]
*[[Apple Inc.]] announces the [[iPhone 16e]], discontinuing all remaining [[lightning (connector)|Lightning port]] [[iPhone]]s and the [[Touch ID|home button]] [[iPhone SE (3rd generation)|third-generation iPhone SE]]. [https://9to5mac.com/2025/02/19/apple-just-discontinued-three-products-the-iphone-se-iphone-14-and-14-plus/ (9to5Mac)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024–25 AFC Champions League Elite]]
**In [[association football]], [[Football in China|Chinese]] club [[Shandong Taishan]] withdraw from the [[AFC Champions League Elite]] several hours before their match against [[Football in South Korea|South Korea]]n club [[Ulsan HD FC|Ulsan HD]]. [https://www.espn.com.sg/soccer/story/_/id/43916137/shandong-taishan-withdrawal-throw-afc-champions-league-elite-disarray (ESPN)] [https://www.scmp.com/sport/football/article/3299269/hong-kong-star-shinichi-chan-scores-shanghai-shenhua-eye-champions-league-progression (''South China Morning Post'')]
